form.label: ClinicalHarmony — Pipeline
form.description: Bronze → Silver → Gold over Kafka: what came in, what each layer did with it, how far behind each consumer is, what was quarantined or dead-lettered, how long a payload takes to reach Gold, and whether every service is up. Logs: index=clinicalharmony; metrics: index=clinicalharmony_metrics. Counts here are LOG EVENTS since Splunk started (Phase 9e); the ClinicalHarmony dashboard counts DATABASE ROWS ever stored — "Built into Gold" is builds (a patient is rebuilt on every Silver change), "Patients built" the distinct patients; Dead letters leaves out the smoke test's deliberate ones (correlation id smoke-…, tagged since 2026-11-23); p95 includes the smoke test's 3-minute bronze-listener outage, p50 is the normal path. Open any correlation id in Trace by correlation id; its Bronze / Silver / master ids link back to the dashboard.

search.query: index=clinicalharmony event="gold.built" | stats dc(silverPatientId) AS patients
index=clinicalharmony event IN ("bronze.stored","bronze.quarantined") | stats count(eval(event="bronze.quarantined")) AS q count AS n | eval rate=if(n=0,0,round(100*q/n,1)) | fields rate
index=clinicalharmony event="*.deadlettered" NOT correlationId="smoke-*" | stats count
index=clinicalharmony event="gold.built" endToEndMs=* | stats perc50(endToEndMs) AS p50 | eval p50=round(p50/1000,1)
index=clinicalharmony event="gold.built" endToEndMs=* | stats perc95(endToEndMs) AS p95 | eval p95=round(p95/1000,1)

index=clinicalharmony event IN ("hl7.published","rest.published","bronze.stored","silver.mapped","gold.built","pmi.run") | eval layer=case(event IN ("hl7.published","rest.published"),"1 intake",event="bronze.stored","2 Bronze",event="silver.mapped","3 Silver",event="gold.built","4 Gold",event="pmi.run","5 PMI runs") | timechart span=1m count BY layer
| mstats max(kafka.consumer_group.lag_sum) AS lag WHERE index=clinicalharmony_metrics span=30s BY group | timechart span=30s max(lag) BY group

panel.title: Bronze outcomes (stored / quarantined / duplicate) and Silver failures

search.query: index=clinicalharmony event IN ("bronze.stored","bronze.quarantined","bronze.duplicate","silver.failed") | timechart span=5m count BY event

panel.title: Dead letters by service (smoke-test records shown apart)

search.query: index=clinicalharmony event="*.deadlettered" | eval origin=if(like(correlationId,"smoke-%"),"smoke test",service) | timechart span=5m count BY origin
index=clinicalharmony event="gold.built" endToEndMs=* | eval s=endToEndMs/1000 | timechart span=5m perc50(s) AS p50 perc95(s) AS p95 max(s) AS max

| mstats max(httpcheck.status) AS up WHERE index=clinicalharmony_metrics AND http.status_class="2xx" earliest=-2m BY http.url | append [| mstats sum(httpcheck.error) AS errors WHERE index=clinicalharmony_metrics earliest=-2m BY http.url] | stats max(up) AS up sum(errors) AS errors BY http.url | rex field=http.url "//(?<service>[^:/]+)" | eval status=if(up=1 AND (isnull(errors) OR errors=0),"UP","DOWN") | table service status http.url | sort service
| rest /servicesNS/-/clinicalharmony/alerts/fired_alerts/- splunk_server=local | eval fired=strftime(trigger_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table fired savedsearch_name severity | sort - fired
